description: Import JSON data into Chaprola format files (.F + .DA). If the target file already exists, Chaprola preserves the existing schema, widens matching fields as needed, keeps legacy fields as blanks, and appends new fields at the end. Use chaprola_alter for explicit in-place schema surgery. Sign BAA first if handling PHI

data.description: JSON array of record objects to import

userid.description: Project owner's username. Required when accessing a shared project where you are a writer. Defaults to the authenticated user.

name: chaprola_import
